contract.scope: 8820 recipes from currently authored modules; future species expand this product. This does not claim every species has every slot.

coverage.warning: Host/part coverage is an efficient first pass, not proof that all complete recipes work.

bonus_policy.selection: Only explicitly approved visual recipes receive a curated name and a proposed signature bonus. Arbitrary recipes remain playable.
bonus_policy.rule: At most one recipe bonus; exact five-slot match; replacing a required part removes it. No stacking or hidden rarity multiplier.
bonus_policy.pve_starting_budget: A situational effect, initially up to 5 percent expected combat value, with a cooldown and a drawback; tune by playtest.
bonus_policy.pvp: Disabled until tested; then trade off base stats to keep the total power budget comparable.
bonus_policy.naming: Existing working names are labels, not approval of a bonus.

review_rules: Finite geometry, correct slot/limb counts and floor clearance.
Check every animated joint against the host surface throughout all seven clips.
Inspect frontal, rear and both side views, including peak jump/attack/wing poses.
Record silhouette, clipping and connection defects separately from whether the creature is charming.
Import and test on the target game runtime; render-only checks never mark runtime passed.
After any part/fit/rig change, invalidate affected recipe checks and rerender previews.

batch.purpose: All six current torsos × none/bee/bat accessory; same bee head and limbs to isolate fitting.
batch.not_covered: Full-body motion, Roblox and all remaining recipes.
